findings.where: First screen at desktop: the hero's 'Write to Mark' button and the palette row below it (the minium swatch and the 'AA' lime-on-minium swatch)
findings.fault: The style tile starts only about 100 px below the button, so the first screen ends in a strip of swatches cut off by the fold. Two of those swatches are solid minium rectangles in the same red and shape as the button, and the 'AA' one even carries light capitals like the button's label. By similarity they read as more red buttons right under the real one, and the calm one-action hero ends in a busy band with no break between the hero and the specimens.
findings.who_objects: Mark, who rules out more than one call to action in view and anything busy (client value 4, §6). The founder also has to judge this hero as the homepage's first moment, and the swatches crowding in under the button blur that.

findings.where: Hero headline, desktop and phone: 'MARK · M · MOSELEY' over 'INFRASTRUCTURE · ADVISOR'
findings.fault: The name and the role are set as one block at one size, weight and colour. On desktop the role line is much wider, so at a squint 'Infrastructure · Advisor' wins and the name reads as the lesser line. With the large arches above it, Mark's name ranks third in the first view.
findings.who_objects: Mark and his audience at the development banks. The brief says the individual is the brand (client values 1 and 3), so the visitor should take in who he is before what he does, and here the generic job title outranks his name.

findings.where: Motion sketch panel: the 'Lay again' control at the foot of the panel (desktop-03, phone-03)
findings.fault: The timeline rows describe the hero mark's arches and band being laid, but the panel holds only the easing curve, not the mark. The replay control sits at the bottom of the page, about two screens on desktop and four on phone below the mark it seems to replay. By proximity it belongs to the curve. If it replays the hero mark, pressing it plays the move off screen and the visitor sees nothing happen.
findings.who_objects: The founder and Mark, who are reviewing the motion sketch so they can judge its timing. They press 'Lay again' to watch the move and either see no change or have to scroll up and miss the start.
